# Fixed colours

The palette's fixed colours (A11.3): `void`, palette index 0, then ink and the colours of the pixel UI (A12.1).
They never change with the light.
Body text is at least 7:1 on its panel, and the dim text, words and links stay well above 4.5:1, so every line reads on the phone in daylight.

## Void

Where nothing is drawn: beyond the edge of the land, and behind the light card.
A deep blue-black rather than pure black, so the dark grey of shade still shows against it.

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Value | #0d0b14 |
| Use | nothing drawn |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "void"
name = "Void"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["PRE-01"]
value = "#0d0b14"
use = "nothing drawn"
```

## Ink

The darkest colour that is not void: figures' outlines, and the checker that dims the world behind a sheet (A12.1).

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Value | #17131c |
| Use | outlines of figures; the dimming checker |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "ink"
name = "Ink"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["PRE-01", "PRE-21"]
value = "#17131c"
use = "outlines of figures; the dimming checker"
```
